prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Layout changes to path selection stages significantly improved conversion.
Interactive walkthrough redesigns, new adoption flows, and sign-in reassurance hints significantly hurt conversion.
Other layout changes, step reordering, copy changes, wait-time info, and photo upload guidance showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too high for interactive walkthrough redesigns, sign-in hints, step reordering, copy changes, and wait-time info.
Predictions were too low for path selection layout changes, underestimating their positive impact.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: -0.0% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: -15.6% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -0.3% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +6.3% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +0.5% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -8.7% over 3 test(s)
- home, redesign: +0.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: -1.2% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -5.4% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, layout: -0.4% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.1% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.5%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Carousel Layout Redesign: Redesign the onboarding story screen using a interactive carousel layout to showcase desktop pet features. (why: The choose_path step sees a high mean time of 514s and 19.5% drop-off; previous path layout upgrades showed strong conversion wins.)
1: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Story Scroll Redesign: Transform the pet generation waiting screen into a story scroll layout highlighting pet lore while processing. (why: Waiting step drop-off is 18.7% with an extremely long mean wait time of 2336s.)
2: [sign_in, layout] Sign In Stage Layout Upgrade: Upgrade the sign-in screen layout to a stage view that highlights account backup benefits clearly. (why: Sign-in drops off 27.1% of users, and 8 support tickets report missing pets after re-signing in.)
3: [finish, copy] Desktop Control Quick Guide Headline Copy: Update headline and body on the final screen with clear instructions on right-clicking and tray controls. (why: 3 support emails report user confusion on how to hide, control, or talk to the pet after onboarding completes.)
4: [home, wait_info] Generation Stage Progress Wait Info: Enable explicit progress status bar and time estimates on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s, leading to drop-off without clear progress indicators.)
5: [home, notification] Background Ready Desktop Notification Toggle: Add an optional system notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet generation finishes. (why: Mean time spent waiting is 2336s, causing users to switch windows and abandon onboarding.)

scores.note: Choose_path redesigns previously yielded a modest +0.2% lift; carousel layout requires new UI release.
Home redesigns historically showed a slight +0.4% lift; story scroll requires new screen development.
High evidence from funnel and 8 support tickets, but sign_in layout changes historically trended slightly negative (-0.4%).
Target step loses 35.2% of users with clear support email evidence; copy updates are easy config changes showing mild positive lift (+0.5%).
Wait-time info previously hurt conversion (-1.2%) and lessons show predictions were historically overoptimistic for wait info.
Addresses the severe 2336s wait time drop-off by keeping out-of-app users engaged, but requires native OS integration release.
